sentence: Deals each person in the chat a hidden set of five dice that only they can see, then shows everyone's dice once all have said ready so bids can be checked.
use_when: The group wants to start a round of liar's dice and needs dice dealt in secret
Everyone needs to see their own dice privately and then reveal them together
A bluffing dice game is being played in chat and someone needs to check a bid
Starting a new round after dice were shown
dont_use_when: Someone just wants a single public dice roll or coin flip
The group wants to track bids, turns or lost dice through a full game
The game needs cards or a board rather than dice
